main_text.l: {A}Ω pro principio & fine, (id est, Ante quod nihil est, &per quod omnia facta sunt, quodque vt omnia intereant, superstes manebit, Esaiæ 41.4. & 43.13. & 44.6. & 48.12.) Apocal. 1.8.11. & 2.8. & 21.6. & 22.13.
[Aa a, ah, ah, Eheu, interiectio dolentis, Ieremiæ 1.6. & 14.13. Ezec. 4.14. 20.49. Ioel. 1.15.]
ABADDON, Antichristi epitheton, Apoc. 9. 11. Græcè, Ἀπολλύων, perdens.
ABARIM, mons Nebo: [Num. 33.47.48.] hinc conspicere terram Chanaan Moses iubetur, Num. 27.12. Deut. 32.49. illic moritur Moses, 34.v.1. &c.

ABBA, vocabulum Syriacum, ter inuenitur in noúo Testamento, Marc. 14.36. Rom. 8.15. Gal. 4.6. & vbique explanandi gratia additur ὁ πατὴρ pater. Abba (Syriacè) patrem appellat Christus, Marc. 14.36. Abba Patrem Deum vocant fideles, Rom. 8.15. Gal. 4.6.
[ABBREVIATIO. Esai. 10.23. & 28.22. Abbreuio, Esai. 50.2. & 59.1. Dan. 9.24. Mich. 2.7. Marc. 13.20. Rom. 9.28.]
ABDEMELECH, Eunuchus Æthiops orat pro liberatione Ieremiæ. Ier. 38.v.8.9. eam impetrat, v.10. procurat & præstat, v.11.12.13. liberatur à gladio Chaldæorum, 39.v.16.17. (i. Seruus Regis.)
ABDENAGO, (i. Seruiens taceo.) appellatur Azarias, & instituitur in disciplina Chal. Dan. 1.7. mittitur in fornacé 3.21.
ABDIAS, (i. Seruus Domini.) œconomus domus Achab, 1. Reg. 18.3. eius pietas in timendo Deo & abscondendis Prophetis Dei, v.3.4.13. alius Zabulonita, 1. Chr. 27.19. & Leuita, 2. Chr. 34.12.
ABDIAS Propheta: eius de Idumæorum excidio vaticinium, Abd. 1.1. [Alius Abdias, 1. Par. 27.19. & 2. Par. 34.12.] Abdiel, (i. Seruus Dei) 1. Par. 5.15.)
ABDON, (i. Seruus mærorís.) Iudex Israelis, Iudic. 12.13. eius mors, v.15.
[ABDON, ciuitas Iof. 21.30. 1. Chr. 6.74. Abdon Beniamitæ F.
